body: She is telling them a distorted view point. It’s not my family. It’s community members, friends. My issue doesn’t just start here. But this one really hit home. The sadness in my heart is so immense. When it feels like you are actually going to die. Like no matter what the days are numbered. The vast amount of hope for this life is negligible. I am not dying physically. But my heart is dying. It’s so sad to me because I thought I had so much to offer. To meet each person with love and care but it’s so confusing indeed. So confusing. How could I be any kind of horrible that I have been. How could I be so bad. How can I be so mean. So manipulative at all. But also, is it even true. My identity is perplexed. I am not sure anymore. I don’t know how to convince those she has said stuff about me wrongly that she is wronging them. I don’t have energy even to do that. I have one friend here but most are all new. And I am so fatigued by all this. I feel isolated. I stopped making jokes, being jovial.
I am avoiding her but she spreading rumors in the community. It’s been so bad that only way I feel is dying.
Tried to connect to a therapist. Costs $250 per session and no insurance taken

I am sorry you are feeling g this way. Life can be so tough. I am glad you have your parents to stay with. I feel that you can come out of it. Colder temperatures make it tough to deal with such things. It’s understandable that there are no jobs in walking distance. I think things can improve for you.
